incumbent_price.note: Shopify listing: Micro $59/mo (up to 5K visits), Growth $179/mo (30K visits), Scale $479/mo (100K visits); annual $490/$1,490/$3,990. Price driven by monthly site visits. Listing rating 3.5 (17 reviews). FTC: Jan 3, 2025 complaint and proposed order, final order approved Apr 22, 2025; accessiBe pays $1 million over claims that accessWidget could make any website WCAG-compliant and over reviews formatted to look independent. Order bars claiming automated products make any site WCAG-compliant or keep it compliant without evidence. Overlay Fact Sheet (1,031 signatories incl. practitioners, disability-rights lawyers, disabled users) says no overlay can make a site fully compliant or remove legal risk and calls for fixing issues at the source. FTC sources: https://www.ftc.gov/news-events/news/press-releases/2025/01/ftc-order-requires-online-marketer-pay-1-million-deceptive-claims-its-ai-product-could-make-websites and https://www.ftc.gov/news-events/news/press-releases/2025/04/ftc-approves-final-order-requiring-accessibe-pay-1-million ; advocates: https://overlayfactsheet.com/en/

entries.switch_note: Removing a script-injected widget is quick, but the real work (fixing theme code, alt text, keyboard access) is a separate project the overlay never did.

alternatives.name: WAVE (WebAIM) free evaluation tool + in-house fixes

Gives a to-do list for fixing issues in theme code at the source
misses: No runtime widget or toolbar for shoppers
No litigation support pledge (accessiBe Growth/Scale list $15K/$20K)
Does not do the fixes itself
Automated checks cannot catch every issue; human review still needed

alternatives.name: One-time accessibility audit (e.g. WebAIM Accessibility Audit) + remediation

price.note: Not found: WebAIM shows no public price, quote on request. Certification cost is folded into the evaluation fee.

covers: Report on conformance, barriers found, their impact on users, and recommended fixes

Fixes at the source, which is what the Overlay Fact Sheet recommends
misses: No ongoing daily automated scan like accessiBe's AI scan
Fixes must be built by you or a developer
